status: source-state stress/pressure and realizability audit; no new holdout test or amplitude correction
inputs: All eight numerically qualified profiles from the frozen coefficient/production matrix; preserve all results

primary_momentum_convention.source: Panchapakesan and Lumley 1993, equation (7), printed pp. 205-206
primary_momentum_convention.formula: J/(2 pi rho A^2)=int eta [F^2 + Rxx - (Rrr+Rtt)/2] d_eta
primary_momentum_convention.scope: Thin-jet cross-stream pressure balance; does not include complete mean radial inertia, axial radial-stress transport, or finite-room effects.

stress_convention: R=(2/3) K identity - 2 N S, N=Cmu K^2/E. Compare the leading radial-shear gradient with the complete gradient of the same self-similar velocity; both have the same normal stresses.
pressure_convention: Pi=-Rrr + int_eta^edge (Rrr-Rtt)/s ds, with zero stress and pressure at the idealized turbulence edge. Integrate pressure independently and compare with the primary normal-stress integral.
realizability: Report eigenvalues without clipping or projection. A violation exceeds 1e-10 times peak K; report lambda_min/K only where K exceeds 1e-12 of its peak, and the fraction of integrated K in violating regions.
numerical_checks: Cartesian finite-difference verification of the axisymmetric gradient
rotation covariance and known realizability violation
edge_treatment: Use the same leading F,K,E powers as the verified free-edge solver; retain the small appended tail and compare delta=0.01 and 0.005. No data-dependent profile renormalization.
interpretation: The computed stress/pressure flux remainder is not SGS kinetic energy, a momentum sink, or a permission to rescale B. Nonzero full-momentum residuals require a consistently solved model and matching to ambient LES. Negative stress eigenvalues cannot seed a particle-velocity covariance.
